intro: Hooters is the American sports-bar chain built on wings, beer and a casual game-day atmosphere, famous for its breaded Hooters Original Style wings and its signature sauces. Beyond wings the menu runs Mile High burgers, seafood including snow crab legs and steamed shrimp, sandwiches, tacos and shareable apps. Below is the full Hooters menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Hooters, 10 traditional wings are about $19.99 and 20 are $32.99, while boneless wings run $13.99 for 8 up to $28.99 for 22. Mile High burgers are $16 to $20, snow crab legs $28.99, and most sandwiches about $16 to $20. The breaded Hooters Original Style wings are the icon. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Hooters value: wing specials (like discounted wings on certain weekdays) and happy-hour deals on apps and drinks are the best-known offers, and the boneless 8-piece ($13.99) or curly fries ($5.99) are the cheapest ways in. The app and Hooters rewards drop occasional deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much are wings at Hooters?
faqs.a: 10 traditional breaded wings are about $19.99 and 20 are $32.99. Boneless wings run $13.99 for 8, $22.19 for 16, and $28.99 for 22. Hooters runs weekday wing specials and happy-hour deals, so the day and location change the price.

Hooters is an American sports-bar chain known for its breaded Hooters Original Style wings, its signature wing sauces, beer and game-day atmosphere, and its Hooters Girls service. The menu also covers burgers, seafood like snow crab, and shareable apps.

faqs.q: Does Hooters have food other than wings?
faqs.a: Yes. Beyond wings, Hooters serves Mile High burgers ($16 to $20), sandwiches and tacos, seafood including snow crab legs ($28.99) and steamed shrimp, big salads, and shareable apps like buffalo shrimp and Tex-Mex nachos.

Hooters publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. Totals vary with the wing style (breaded versus boneless), the sauce, and the sides you add.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Hooters?
faqs.a: Favorites include the traditional breaded wings, the boneless wings, the buffalo shrimp, the Mile High burgers, and the snow crab legs.
